title: Concept: Dependency declared with the GitHub shorthand
description: package.json declares the `github:` dependency shorthand, which resolves a repository default branch, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The shorthand follows whatever branch the repository publishes, so the installed tree can change without any manifest edit.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The shorthand follows whatever branch the repository publishes, so the installed tree can change without any manifest edit.
